sources.name: SecBench.js
sources.license: No repository license declared (GitHub API license is null)
sources.notes: Publicly reported server-side JavaScript package vulnerabilities from advisory sources. README states exploit tests, metadata, source links, fixed-version/commit fields when available, and five vulnerability classes. The pinned commit inventory has 600 category package metadata files: 40 code injection, 101 command injection, 170 path traversal, 192 prototype pollution, 97 ReDoS.

sources.name: OpenSSF CVE Benchmark
sources.notes: Historical real CVEs with vulnerable and patched codebase analysis; strong differential-SAST source. This catalog does not list individual cases from it because its inventory was not harvested here.

sources.name: x.js live Node.js benchmark
sources.license: CC-BY-4.0 for paper; benchmark artifact license/link not established from accessed paper
sources.available_cases: 1,159 validated exploits for 965 packages; built from 1,738 advisories through mid-2026
sources.notes: Paper reports code injection, command injection, prototype pollution and path traversal cases with source/sink locations, execution traces, and patch pairing when available. No public case inventory was harvested because the accessed primary paper did not provide one.

sources.name: GitHub Advisory Database
sources.available_cases: Live npm advisory slice; filter/query required
sources.notes: Public individual OSV-format advisories with GHSA IDs, affected ranges, references and, where known, fix commits. Use as a refreshable selector, then pin the advisory file revision and target package release.

sources.name: OSV.dev
sources.license: Varies by underlying data source; OSV format is open
sources.available_cases: Live aggregated npm inventory; query required
sources.notes: Aggregates OSV-format sources and supports package-version and commit queries. Use it for version-range pre-screening; retain original advisory provenance for a benchmark case.

sources.name: PoCGen datasets
sources.available_cases: SecBench.js inventory plus a GHSA 2025–2026 input list; no independent total asserted here
sources.notes: A public research artifact that consumes advisory IDs and includes evaluation datasets. It is useful for harness/layout ideas, not independent confirmation of a candidate.

sources.name: OWASP Juice Shop
sources.available_cases: Intentionally vulnerable challenges; no static count asserted
sources.notes: Training/CTF application, not a historical vulnerability dataset. Listed only as an explicitly labelled project candidate.

sources.name: OWASP NodeGoat
sources.available_cases: OWASP Top 10 training coverage; no static count asserted
sources.notes: Intentionally vulnerable training application. Listed only as an explicitly labelled project candidate.

sources.available_cases: OWASP Top 10 training coverage; no static count asserted
sources.notes: Intentionally vulnerable training application with fixes branches. Listed only as an explicitly labelled project candidate.
